Interface TestRunner

All Known Implementing Classes:
JUnitPlatformTestRunner
public interface TestRunner
Runs tests, streaming what happens.

Implementations are discovered through META-INF/services and chosen by id(); the JUnit Platform runner is built in. A runner owns discovery and execution; development mode owns which tests run, the loaders, and the reports. A runner that is asked to cancel stops as soon as it can and reports the run as cancelled.

      TestRunSummary run(TestRunRequest request, TestEventListener listener, Cancellation cancellation)
